final_message:
The extended-precision rerun hit its background time limit and was stopped before it produced any results. I'm not restarting it: the answer never relied on it, and the checks I reported still hold. The final result stands at **G_DD = 2.5505 × 10⁻⁹ S/cm**.

reported.method: Converged the DEVSIM DC solution at V_D = ±δ (δ = 1e-6, 1e-4, 1e-3 V) with V_G = 0.488174 V via circuit_alter on V1 and M.solve_dc(), and took the central difference of the drain current through V1 (V1.I); δ = 1e-4 V gives 2.55050e-9 S/cm.
reported.verification: FD result is the same for δ = 1e-6 and 1e-4 V and within 0.02% at 1e-3 V; Newton converged quadratically; the electron current across channel cuts (2.5455e-9) plus the drain-side body current (~5e-12) balances the drain current; scaled linearized solve gives the same channel-cut conductance (2.5454e-9). DEVSIM's built-in AC solve (6.6e-8) and get_contact_current are dominated by rounding error at the 1e20 cm^-3 contacts and were rejected. An extended-precision rerun hit its time limit and produced no results.
